messages:
kevin: heads up — after yesterday's kernel-selector change we saw a tail-latency spike on T4 for kv-heavy chat workloads. can we sync on adjusting burst/credit policies per device?
sophia: saw the same in profiler. p95 tokens/sec dropped ~22% on T4 when KV cache hits > 30%. A100 unaffected. attached snippet of flame briefly: `kernel: fused_attn` and lots of memory copies.
marta: T4 is filling up with small requests that get packed into big token batches, then kernel choice switches to slower path. my quick thought: reduce max_tokens_per_batch for T4 and L4, increase burst credits for A100/H100.
juan: FYI kernel-selector heuristic currently uses seq_len+batch_size threshold only. it doesn't account for kv_cache_ratio or kv_eviction churn. that mismatch is probably tripping fused vs non-fused decisions.
ben: concrete numbers from canary: T4 p95 latency 420ms -> 520ms when kv_hit_rate > 0.3; throughput stable but cost up due to retries.
samir: propose a three-part change: 1) add kv-aware signal into kernel selector, 2) device-specific token ceilings (max_tokens_batch), 3) new queue policy to prefer packing requests with similar kv states. flip via canary on 10% traffic.
sophia: profiling logs I pulled:
```
# sample event
device=T4 kernel=fused_attn memcpy_ms=12 kernel_ms=48 kv_lookup_ms=18 tail_ms=86
```
That extra kv_lookup_ms is the culprit.
marta: suggested device ceilings (initial): A100/H100 max_tokens_batch=131072, burst_credits=16; A10 max_tokens_batch=65536, burst_credits=12; L4 max_tokens_batch=24576, burst_credits=6; T4 max_tokens_batch=16384, burst_credits=4.
juan: +1 but let's also cap batch_on_kv=true batches to smaller token budgets so we avoid selecting fused_attn when kv overhead dominates.
kevin: agree. samir can you draft the config proto and a minimal implementation for kernel-selector kv_flag? include telemetry hooks for: kernel_choice, kv_hit_rate, packed_batch_tokens, p95_latency.
samir: will do. initial config proto (pseudo):
```
device_policies:
  T4: {max_tokens_batch:16384,burst_credits:4,kv_aware: true,kv_token_ceiling:8192}
  L4: {max_tokens_batch:24576,burst_credits:6,kv_aware: true,kv_token_ceiling:12288}
  A10: {max_tokens_batch:65536,burst_credits:12,kv_aware: false}
  A100: {max_tokens_batch:131072,burst_credits:16,kv_aware: false}
  H100: {max_tokens_batch:131072,burst_credits:16,kv_aware: false}
```
we can tune kv_token_ceiling empirically.
ben: capture experiment metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, evicted_kv_entries, kernel_switch_rate, cost_per_token.
infra-bot: deploy planned: canary config push to ring=canary-10 at 2056792000 by samir.
sophia: quick checklist: - add kv_hit_rate to per-request tags - add kernel_choice to traces - rollout schedule: canary 10% -> 40% -> 100% if p95 regressions <= 5% and evictions <= baseline*1.2.
marta: also add a fallback: if fused_attn chosen but kv_lookup_ms > 30% of total, fallback to alternative kernel next request (cheap rollback). keeps tail in check.
kevin: great. Samir, aim to have PR + benchmark trace by EOD tomorrow. we'll review before canary. thanks all.
